question: The Asiatic lion population largely resides in the protected park area of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gir National Park**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Asiatic lion population** largely resides in the protected park area of **Gir National Park**.
 
• **Gir National Park** is located in the state of **Gujarat, India**.
 
• The park is the only natural habitat of the **Asiatic lions** and is crucial for their conservation.
 
• Efforts have been made to protect these lions from poaching and habitat loss, resulting in a stable population.
 
• The park also hosts a variety of other wildlife including leopards, deer, and numerous bird species.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gir National Park** was established in **1965** and covers an area of approximately **1,412 square kilometers**.
 
• The park is also known as the **Sasan-Gir** and is a major tourist attraction in Gujarat.
 
• Conservation programs in Gir National Park include habitat management, prey base augmentation, and community involvement in conservation efforts.
 
• The **Forest Department of Gujarat** conducts regular census operations to monitor the lion population and health.
 
• Visitors to the park can experience guided safaris to see the Asiatic lions in their natural habitat.
